source: existing untyped BODY_CONTRACTS.Operation plus explicit typed compiler bindings
source_compatibility: typed Operation v1 is not silently reinterpreted; existing parser and defaults stay unchanged
inputs: explicit core typed parameters; live read results and Event constructor inputs occupy separately declared slots
reads: exact declared slot coverage; Entity target and typed identity-key expression; key depends only on initial parameters; live results are supplied inside the transaction
guards: all enforcing declared typed Rules, including the named primary guard; exact parameter types; no inline predicates
writes: exact declared slot coverage; create, replace or delete an explicitly typed Entity value; writes are value/effect bindings, not a new domain relationship
events: exact declared effect-slot coverage; Event constructor input parameter and existing produced Event target; no implicit publication
result: explicit typed success value expression; source failure_continuation remains unchanged

relationships.reads: Operation to Entity targets exactly match read bindings
relationships.creates: Operation to Entity targets exactly match distinct create targets
relationships.produces: Operation to Event targets exactly match distinct Event targets
relationships.enforces: Rule to Operation sources exactly match guard bindings
relationships.mutates: UI Binding to Operation; never used as an Entity write edge

checkpoints: prepare all writes and Event data
execution_contract.precommit_failure: no partial state or outbox mutation
execution_contract.commit_uncertainty: indeterminate, not a false rollback or safe automatic retry
execution_contract.provider_boundary: compiler must bind an atomic provider; a descriptor or callback acknowledgement alone does not prove durability
execution_contract.clock: only explicit Event clock dependencies; no ambient clock

validation_ceiling: checked compiler input and relationships; not action execution, atomicity, durability or public CLI integration
